subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick demo & timing
messages:
From: Alex Webster <alex@capitolhealth.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Hosted API trial - quick demo request

Hi Stephanie,

I signed up for the Hosted API trial this morning (Capitol Health / Alex Webster). We're evaluating hosted endpoints for a pilot: low-latency routing, cost per token, and potential private deployment for PHI-sensitive flows.

Would love a short 20-30 minute demo/technical walkthrough to see how Redwood handles:
- predictable latency at 50–100 concurrent requests
- KV cache / prefix caching for long context
- model quantization/variants that affect throughput/cost

Availability next week is a bit tight on our side — best windows for me are Wed 11/3 after 1pm ET or Thu 11/4 morning ET. My lead engineer Priya Malhotra (cc'd) will join.

Do you have an engineer available to do a short deep-dive? Also, if you have a brief one-pager on quickstart steps for PLG leads, that would help us prep.

Thanks,
Alex Webster
Product Lead, Capitol Health
alex@capitolhealth.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Webster <alex@capitolhealth.ai>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya@capitolhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T18:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API trial - quick demo request

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually) and congrats on getting started with the trial. Happy to run the 20–30 minute technical walkthrough and have an engineer join.

Options I can offer next week (all in ET):
- Wed 11/3 1:30–2:00pm ET
- Thu 11/4 9:00–9:30am ET
- Thu 11/4 11:00–11:30am ET

If none of those work, tell me two times that do and I’ll do my best to accommodate. For the walkthrough we typically cover: quick hosted integration (API keys, headers), routing/fallbacks, KV cache behavior, and per-route cost/latency tradeoffs — and we’ll leave 5–10 minutes for your specific questions.

Attaching a one-pager with the PLG quickstart and a short SOC 2 checklist that customers often ask about. I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Also looping in Dylan Brooks (solutions) in case we want a deeper performance/benchmark convo.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/plg-hostedapi-30m

Attachment: PLG-quickstart-one-pager.pdf
From: Alex Webster <alex@capitolhealth.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya@capitolhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T02:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API trial - quick demo request

Thanks, Stephanie — appreciate the options. Thu 11/4 11:00–11:30am ET works best for us. Could we move it 15 minutes earlier (10:45–11:15am ET) if that helps your engineer's schedule? Priya and I will be on the call; also inviting our infra lead, Michael Chen (michael@capitolhealth.ai).

We'd prefer the session to be engineering-forward — mostly hands-on (sample requests, perf numbers, quick walkthrough of KV cache behavior). If Dylan can bring any benchmark numbers for 8k/32k contexts on A100-equivalent instances, that'd be very helpful.

I attached our SOC2 questions spreadsheet so you have context; feel free to forward to your security folks if needed.

Looking forward,
Alex

Attachment: capitol-soc2-questions.xlsx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Webster <alex@capitolhealth.ai>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya@capitolhealth.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API trial - quick demo request

Alex — confirmed. We can do Thu 11/4 10:45–11:15am ET (15 min start earlier). I created the invite and attached the .ics (invite-stephanie-ics.ics).

Dylan will join as our Solutions Engineer and bring the benchmark summary for 8k/32k contexts on our tested instance classes. We'll kick off with a two-minute agenda, do a short live demo of the hosted API integration (including a quick prefix cache example), then show measured latency and cost numbers for a small synthetic workload.

Agenda (brief):
- 2 min intros & goal alignment
- 10 min live walkthrough: key integration points, caching, routing, model variants
- 10 min performance & cost summary (Q&A)

If you want us to run any specific sample prompt or share a test key ahead of time, tell us and we'll prepare. Otherwise, see you Thu 11/4 at 10:45am ET.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0198
